title: Tuesday @ 1130   ISA Shootout – a Comparison of RISC V, ARM, and x86   Chris Celio, UC Berkeley V2
summary: Chris Celio of UC Berkeley compares the RISC-V, ARM and x86 instruction sets, with quantitative data on instruction counts and code density. It examines how the compressed extension fares against Thumb and x86.
why: Cited as primary-source evidence that RISC-V code density is competitive with or better than ARM and x86.
